answer: Farming becomes a marble bet on surviving 75 epochs of grading, and every fable settlement recomputes the nectar schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 75 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 19 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
